name: Companies House iXBRL filing software for micro-companies
what: Build self-serve iXBRL accounts-preparation and filing software for small and micro UK companies.
trigger: From 1 April 2028, all UK registered companies must file accounts through commercial software; web and paper accounts filing routes close.
notes: Companies House confirmed software-only filing on 23 October 2026. It paused the proposed profit-and-loss filing requirement for small and micro entities; do not build around that paused measure. Product demand and pricing unverified.
